headlines.title: Wisconsin reports its first measles death in decades, the third in the U.S. this week
headlines.description: The infant’s death followed a measles-associated death reported Wednesday in Pennsylvania and another Monday in New York.

headlines.title: 5 healthcare fights Democrats could take on after midterms sweep
headlines.description: Democrats will have leverage to try to restore the expired Obamacare tax credits, reverse Medicaid cuts and push for changes they say would make healthcare more affordable.

headlines.title: Muscle health is key to longevity. Here’s how to measure yours.
headlines.description: Body mechanics experts say muscle health is linked to our longevity and how well we fight off disease.

headlines.title: New York reports first measles death in more than 30 years
headlines.description: So far this year, the state has reported 178 measles cases.

headlines.title: Daylight saving time ends Sunday. Here’s what to know as clocks ‘fall back.’
headlines.description: Clocks across much of the United States will fall back once again Sunday as daylight saving time comes to an end.

headlines.title: Richard Norton, actor and martial artist, died after peptides triggered heart attack, coroner says
headlines.description: Australian actor and martial artist Richard Norton, who faced off in movies against Chuck Norris and Jackie Chan, died of a heart attack tiggered by peptides, according to a coroner’s report.

headlines.title: Nearly half of U.S. teens ages 13 to 17 say they’ve gambled in the last year, survey finds
headlines.description: The report’s lead author said minors now have more access to gambling through “video games, sports broadcasts and other products.”

headlines.title: Many on ACA plans face a new crisis in 2027: Insurers fleeing the market
headlines.description: Eleven insurers have announced plans to leave some state ACA marketplaces in 2027.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: U.S. on verge of losing measles elimination status as number of cases grows
headlines.description: The United States is on the verge of losing its measles elimination status as cases top 5,000 nationwide for the first time in more than three decades. Pennsylvania, New York and Wisconsin have all reported measles-related deaths this week.

headlines.title: Which Viral Skin Care Ingredients Are Worth it and Which to Skip
headlines.description: From copper peptides to PDRN made from salmon DNA, social media is filled with advice and viral skin care ingredients, but which products actually deserve a spot in your routine? Board-certified dermatologist Marnie Nussbaum joins TODAY to break it all down.

headlines.title: Insurance denied her cancer treatment. One email changed everything.
headlines.description: After her insurer denied a milder chemotherapy her oncologist prescribed, breast cancer patient Elizabeth Nicholas emailed the CEO — and got it approved 14 hours later. NBC News' Kate Snow reports.
